text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! What a lovely morning!
Good morning, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yesterday I visited the
Umamusume Kiddie Club for the first time in a while!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The kids took such a liking to me! They even said,
'When I grow up, I'm going to Tracen Academy, so wait for me!'-type things!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that really warmed my heart.
I hope those girls can meet Trainers they can trust from the bottom of their hearts someday, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Narita Top Road was able to
spend a very fulfilling day off.
